record.body:
## Problem

The repo still tracks the store files, and the docs, hooks, CI and worktrees assume the file layout.

## Approach

Switch this repo to the DB store, untrack the record files, update AGENTS.md, hooks and CI, and bind worktrees to the shared DB. Decide the CI store validation at settle-phase. This phase is the end-to-end verification.

## Exit criteria

- The full suite, `canon validate`, `orchestra handoff` and the dashboard run against the DB through the real CLI. Verified by running each.
- `git ls-files .canon` lists no record files. Verified by running it.
- Full CI passes on a pushed branch. Verified by a CI run observation.

payload.title: Switch this repo to the DB and untrack the files

record.subject: cutover
